categories.title: Eye Examination and General Eye Health

topics.title: Eye Examination
topics.description: A process in which visual acuity, the anterior and posterior structures of the eye, and required tests are evaluated together.

topics.title: Conjunctivitis
topics.description: Covers the evaluation of irritation and inflammatory conditions related to the conjunctiva, the layer covering the front surface of the eye.

topics.title: Stye
topics.description: Covers the evaluation of local eyelid gland issues that may present with redness, tenderness and swelling on the eyelid.

topics.title: Chalazion
topics.description: Covers the evaluation of localised swellings that may develop due to blockage of the oil glands in the eyelid.

topics.title: Laser Eye Surgery
topics.description: Suitability for laser procedures in refractive errors is evaluated after a detailed eye examination.

topics.title: Myopia
topics.description: A refractive error that may cause distant objects to appear blurred.

topics.title: Astigmatism
topics.description: A refractive error that may cause blurred or distorted vision due to irregularities in the optical structure of the eye.

topics.title: Hyperopia
topics.description: A refractive error that may be associated with difficulty seeing at close range.

topics.title: What Is Cataract?
topics.description: Cataract is a condition associated with the natural lens inside the eye losing its transparency.

topics.title: Cataract Surgery
topics.description: Surgical options for cataract are evaluated according to examination findings and individual needs.

topics.title: Intraocular Lens
topics.description: Intraocular lens options are evaluated according to eye structure and visual needs.

topics.title: Trifocal Lens
topics.description: Covers the evaluation of multifocal lens options for distance, intermediate and near vision needs.

topics.title: Macular Degeneration
topics.description: Covers the evaluation of conditions that may affect the macula, the area responsible for central vision.

topics.title: Retina
topics.description: The retina is the light-sensitive layer at the back of the eye involved in processing visual images.

topics.title: Uveitis
topics.description: Covers the evaluation of inflammatory conditions that may affect the uvea layer of the eye.

topics.title: Ptosis
topics.description: Covers the evaluation of conditions in which the upper eyelid may affect the opening of the eye.

topics.title: Eyelid Aesthetics
topics.description: Functional or aesthetic assessments related to the eyelid region are planned with consideration of eye and facial structure.

topics.title: Orbital Surgery
topics.description: Covers surgical assessments related to the bone and soft tissue structures around the eye.

topics.title: Eye Surgery
topics.description: Options related to eye surgery are evaluated according to diagnosis, examination findings and individual needs.

topics.title: Strabismus
topics.description: Covers the evaluation of conditions related to the alignment and coordinated movement of the eyes.
